verdict.rationale: Treasury Prime documents a Postman Collection for exploring its APIs. That is a downloadable, machine-readable description of the endpoints, a rough equivalent of a spec, but it is not an OpenAPI document. A probe of common OpenAPI/Swagger paths returned 404 on every candidate, and the llms.txt file is a docs index, not an API spec. Missing for 10: a published, downloadable OpenAPI (or equivalent schema-level) spec, documentation of where and how to obtain it, and independent confirmation that the Postman Collection is complete and current.
